reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Improving health services access to strengthen the sustainability and quality of the national TB and HIV response

description.narrative: Lao (Peoples Democratic Republic) - TB/HIV - Ministry of Health of the Lao People's Democratic Republic - MOH. This program has the following goals: Reaching the unreached to End TB in Lao PDR. End the transmission and impact of HIV/AIDS and STI in Lao PDR by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To increase the TB treatment coverage through finding and treating the missing DS-TB and DR-TB cases. To increase the uptake of TB/DR-TB preventive therapy (TPT) among eligible population. To improve the management of patients affected by drug resistant tuberculosis. To improve access to quality HIV prevention and testing services. To increase access to quality HIV treatment and care services
